<!doctype html>
<html lang="sv">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>ALUNIX</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/lenis.css">

<style>
@font-face{
  font-family:"Geist";
  src:url("assets/fonts/geist-500-latin.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-weight:500; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}
@font-face{
  font-family:"Geist Mono";
  src:url("assets/fonts/geist-mono-400-latin.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-weight:400; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}

:root{
  --paper:#ffffff;
  --ink:#232323;
  --black:#000000;
  --grey:#d9d9d9;
  --mint:#0af474;
  --mint-soft:#a3fbcb;
  --rust:#9c5a3a;
  --lacquer:#b23524;
  --seam:1px solid #000;

  --headline-50:clamp(3.25rem, 0.418rem + 12.082vw, 12.5rem);
  --headline-40:clamp(2.5rem, 1.352rem + 4.9vw, 6.25rem);
  --headline-20:clamp(2rem, 1.694rem + 1.306vw, 3rem);
  --h3:38px;
  --body:16px;
  --body-30:clamp(1.5rem, 1.347rem + 0.653vw, 2rem);
  --caption:13px;
  --cellpad:20px;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{color-scheme:light;}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:#000;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:"Geist","Arial",system-ui,sans-serif;
  font-weight:500;
  line-height:1.3;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono","Consolas",monospace;font-weight:400;}
h1,h2,h3,p,ol,ul,figure{margin:0;padding:0;}
a{color:inherit;}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- rutverket shell */
.rutverk{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;background:#000;}
.rutverk > section{scroll-margin-top:48px;}

.g{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.cell{background:var(--paper);padding:var(--cellpad);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cell--pad0{padding:0;}
.cell--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--black{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--grey{background:var(--grey);color:var(--ink);}
.cell--mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--black);}
.cell--rust{background:var(--rust);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--lacquer{background:var(--lacquer);color:var(--paper);}

.g12{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .g12{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .g12{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .g12 > *{grid-column:1 / -1 !important;}
}

.c-2{grid-column:span 2;}
.c-3{grid-column:span 3;}
.c-4{grid-column:span 4;}
.c-5{grid-column:span 5;}
.c-6{grid-column:span 6;}
.c-7{grid-column:span 7;}
.c-8{grid-column:span 8;}
.c-12{grid-column:span 12;}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .c-7,.c-5,.c-8,.c-4{grid-column:span 6;}
}

.headline-50{font-size:var(--headline-50);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.headline-40{font-size:var(--headline-40);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.headline-20{font-size:var(--headline-20);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.h3{font-size:var(--h3);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;}
.body{font-size:var(--body);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.body-30{font-size:var(--body-30);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.caption{font-size:var(--caption);letter-spacing:0;}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- topline */
.topline{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;height:48px;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:1px;background:#000;
}
.topline-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 20px;}
.topline-logo{width:auto;height:22px;}
.topline-mark{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;}
.topline-mid{background:var(--paper);}
.topline-contact{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;justify-content:flex-end;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- hero */
/* R3: the fixed 190svh CSS-sticky stage is gone. The pin distance is now
   owned by ScrollTrigger's own pinSpacing (desktop matchMedia branch,
   RORELSE-SPEC.md §2); hero-wrap just needs to size to its content so a
   no-JS/pre-JS view still shows one full stage, not a dead 90svh gap. */
.hero-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;}
.hero-stage{
  position:relative;height:calc(100svh - 48px);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  gap:1px;background:#000;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* Mobile drops the pin: no extra scroll-span, no sticky stage. The four
     cells stack in normal flow (each already min-height:60vw, so the
     stack is naturally taller than one screen) and the card flips against
     that natural scroll distance instead of a dedicated dead-space span. */
  .hero-wrap{height:auto;}
  .hero-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,minmax(60vw,auto));height:auto;position:relative;top:0;}
}
.hero-cell{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-ov{background:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.hero-oh{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nv{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nh{background:var(--mint);}
.hero-h1{max-width:14ch;}

.dither-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.color-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}

/* card: a physical object (light stock, ink edge, hard offset shadow) so
   it reads against a black cell instead of disappearing into it. ~1.6x
   the R1 size at 1440 (was ~340px wide, now ~520px), 85:55 kept. */
.card-anchor{
  position:absolute;left:75%;top:50%;
  width:min(36vw,520px);
  aspect-ratio:85/55;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  perspective:1600px;
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@media (max-width:767px){ .card-anchor{left:50%;top:120vw;width:min(74vw,380px);} }
.card-flip{
  width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
  transform:rotateY(calc(var(--flip,0) * 180deg));
  box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;
}
.face{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:#fff;
  backface-visibility:hidden;
  border:1px solid #000;
  overflow:hidden;
}
/* A visible white mat around the photo, not a full-bleed image: a card
   that is a photo edge-to-edge reads as "the photo", not as "a light
   stock object sitting on the cell" - the mat is what makes the white
   stock actually visible against a black ÖH ground. */
.face--front{background:#fff;padding:6%;}
/* R6 bugfix: kontakt's front is a <button> wrapping <span>s (spans, unlike
   hero's <div>s, default to display:inline) - an inline, merely
   position:relative .photo never gets a real box (width/height are ignored
   on non-replaced inline elements), so it collapsed to a ~2px sliver and
   the absolutely-positioned img inside inherited that zero-size containing
   block. display:block here makes both tags behave identically. */
.face--front .photo{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
.face--back{
  transform:rotateY(180deg);
  background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:6% 8%;
}
.face--front img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.mark-dock{position:absolute;top:9%;left:9%;width:14%;z-index:2;}
.mark-dock svg{width:100%;height:auto;fill:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7));}
.card-mark{font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;}
.card-kicker{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,14px);opacity:.65;margin:2px 0 0;}
.card-rule{border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25);margin:6px 0;width:100%;}
.card-services{display:flex;gap:10px;font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(10px,1.1vw,13px);}
.card-cta{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;margin-top:4px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- tes */
.tes-top{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.tes-top .headline-50{max-width:22ch;}
.tes-lower{min-height:104svh;}
.tes-stack{display:grid;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:#000;}
.tes-line{padding:var(--cellpad);display:flex;align-items:center;}
.tes-image{padding:0;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- process */
.process-row{}
.process-left{background:var(--grey);}
.process-sticky{position:sticky;top:calc(48px + var(--cellpad));}
.process-kicker{margin-bottom:14px;}
.process-title{margin:0 0 18px;max-width:11ch;}
.process-lock{max-width:32ch;opacity:.8;}
.process-image{position:relative;margin-top:32px;aspect-ratio:1/1;width:100%;max-width:680px;border:1px solid #000;overflow:hidden;}
.process-right{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0;}
.process-steps{list-style:none;}
.process-row-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:22px var(--cellpad);border-top:1px solid #000;}
.process-row-item:first-child{border-top:none;}
.process-num{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:13px;padding-top:4px;}
.process-step-title{margin:0 0 6px;}
.process-p{color:#bdbdbd;max-width:56ch;font-size:15px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- exempelcase */
/* R5 §A bugfix: 0.6x bottom padding (12px) was less than the SplitText
   mask-breathe allowance (0.16em, ~16-20px at this clamp size) needs to
   clear the word's own descenders before the cell's overflow:hidden edge
   - verify_motion.py's legibility scan caught the word's rendered box
   (with its mask wrapper's padding-bottom) genuinely sitting a few px
   below the cell's clip boundary at every scroll position (0vh visible,
   not >=40vh). Matching the top padding removes the clip entirely. */
.case-word-cell{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4 + 4px);overflow:hidden;}
.case-word-cell .headline-50{max-width:100%;}

/* R5 §B1: väljaren - två knappar, skarpa 1440x900-vyer, ingen beskärande zoom */
.case-picker-cell{padding:0 var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.2);background:#000;}
.case-picker{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.case-choice{
  display:block;width:100%;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:var(--paper);color:inherit;
  font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
}
.case-choice-frame{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:var(--grey);}
.case-choice-frame img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);will-change:transform;}
@media (hover:hover){
  .case-choice:hover .case-choice-frame img,
  .case-choice:focus-visible .case-choice-frame img{transform:scale(1.04);}
}
.case-choice:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:-2px;}
.case-choice-meta{display:block;padding:16px var(--cellpad) 20px;border-bottom:4px solid transparent;}
.case-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .case-choice-meta{border-bottom-color:var(--mint);}
.case-choice-meta .h3{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:22px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- showcase (B2/C) */
.showcase-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
@media (min-width:768px){ .showcase-stage{grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;} }
.showcase-embed-cell{padding:0;background:var(--paper);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-frame-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-poster{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.showcase-embed-cell iframe{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1440px;height:900px;border:0;background:var(--paper);
  transform-origin:top left;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .showcase-embed-cell{position:sticky;top:48px;height:56svh;z-index:2;}
}
@media (min-width:768px){
  /* R6 §3, two stacked causes, both fixed here:
     1) .showcase-side's natural content (all 5/6 rows, R5's rise-mask kept
        every body visible at once) was taller than the embed cell's
        explicit height. A CSS grid item with an explicit height does not
        stretch to match a taller sibling's row track - the TRACK grows to
        fit the tall side instead, leaving the embed cell short of the
        row's actual height by the difference (measured ~110px), exposing
        the stage's own black gap background below the frame. Pinning both
        columns to the SAME explicit height (with the side's own
        overflow-y:auto as a never-clip safety net) makes them structurally
        impossible to mismatch, regardless of how much text a future edit
        adds.
     2) That explicit height was `100svh - 48px`, sized to sit BELOW the
        48px sticky topline - but the pin (`start:'top top'`) puts the
        section's rendered top at the viewport's own y:0, with the topline
        merely painted on top of (not offsetting) its first 48px. The
        result: content correctly avoids the topline visually, but then
        runs 48px short of the viewport's bottom edge, showing the stage's
        black background as a trailing band under both columns (measured:
        embed/side bottom at 852 of a 900-tall viewport). Hero's own pin
        has this identical 48px arithmetic and gap - invisible there only
        because it lands on the page's own black background either side.
        Showcase's is visible because there's real content flush above it.
        Fixed the same way hero's is invisible: fill the FULL viewport
        (100svh) - the topline still visually covers the top 48px (it's
        position:sticky, z-index:40, opaque), but the bottom now lands
        exactly on the viewport edge, so no gap is left to expose. */
  .showcase-embed-cell{height:100svh;}
  .showcase-side{height:100svh;overflow-y:auto;}
}
.showcase-side{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.showcase-panel{display:contents;}
.showcase-head{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad);}
.showcase-head .headline-40{margin-bottom:8px;}

/* R7 §C: the accordion ledger (R6 §1/§2) is replaced on desktop by a single
   crossfading box - one background for the whole "ruta", every step
   grid-stacked in one cell and GSAP-scrubbed by the showcase pin's onUpdate
   (never a class-toggle). Mobile keeps R6's stacked-rows layout unchanged;
   only its opacity mechanism changes (measured contrast fix, see below). */
.showcase-row{padding:var(--cellpad);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
.showcase-row h3{margin-bottom:0;}
.showcase-row p{max-width:52ch;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px;}

@media (min-width:768px){
  .showcase-rows{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;height:100%;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-rows{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-rows{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-box-head{padding:var(--cellpad) var(--cellpad) 0;}
  .showcase-counter{display:block;font-size:13px;}
  .showcase-track{position:relative;height:4px;margin-top:10px;}
  .showcase-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:#000;transform:translateY(-50%);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-track::before{background:var(--paper);opacity:.3;}
  .showcase-track-fill{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:4px;background:var(--mint);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0);}
  .showcase-steps{display:grid;height:100%;}
  .showcase-row{grid-area:1/1;height:100%;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .showcase-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;background:#000;}
  .showcase-box-head{display:none;}
  .showcase-steps{display:contents;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd) p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- pris */
.pris-statement{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.pris-statement .body-30{max-width:60ch;margin-top:16px;font-weight:500;}
/* All placement lives in these classes (not inline styles) so the media
   queries below can actually win the cascade at each breakpoint. */
.pris-bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);grid-template-rows:auto auto;}
.pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 6;grid-row:1 / span 2;background:var(--mint);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.pris-tier{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;min-height:220px;}
.pris-tier-a{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:1;background:var(--paper);}
.pris-tier-b{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:2;background:var(--grey);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 2;grid-row:1;}
  .pris-tier-a{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;}
  .pris-tier-b{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .pris-lead,.pris-tier-a,.pris-tier-b{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;min-height:0;}
}
.price-label{max-width:34ch;font-size:15px;}
.price-value{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.price-value .unit{font-size:.5em;margin-left:2px;}
.price-value--text{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px);}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- kontakt (R5 §C: heron speglad) */
.kontakt-quad{
  position:relative;display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;min-height:100svh;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-areas:"ov oh" "nv nh";
}
.kontakt-q{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.kontakt-q--ov{grid-area:ov;background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;}
/* R6 §4: headline-40 is tuned for a single "jätteord" (hero, case names) -
   at this cell's half-page width, a four-word sentence in it ran past the
   ÖV/ÖH seam (measured x>720 at 1440, into the card's own space). A
   smaller, dedicated clamp - same family as the old kontakt-giant's - fits
   three lines comfortably inside the cell at 1440/1280/768, verified with
   getBoundingClientRect against the cell box, not eyeballed. */
.kontakt-q--ov h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.75rem, 1.1rem + 2.6vw, 3.4rem);line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:500;max-width:12ch;
}
.kontakt-q--ov p{max-width:32ch;font-size:15px;}
.kontakt-q--oh{grid-area:oh;background:var(--paper);}
.kontakt-q--nv{grid-area:nv;background:var(--grey);padding:0;}
.kontakt-q--nh{grid-area:nh;background:var(--mint);}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* R6 §7: nh gets more room than ov/nv (was the same minmax(60vw) as
     both) - a 3D Y-axis rotation's perspective projection genuinely bulges
     a flat card's rendered bounding box taller at the near edge as it
     turns (measured: +/-28px top/bottom at 1200px perspective, still
     +/-24px at 3000px - foreshortening a rotated rectangle really does
     grow its axis-aligned bbox, not a rounding artefact), and centring an
     88%-wide card in a 60vw-tall row left only ~27px clearance to the
     subline above - not enough to survive that bulge at any angle in the
     0-180deg sweep. */
  .kontakt-quad{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(60vw,auto) minmax(76vw,auto) minmax(60vw,auto);grid-template-areas:"ov" "nh" "nv";min-height:auto;}
  .kontakt-q--oh{display:none;}
}

/* the card sits on the crossing of all four quadrants (a grid item that
   spans the full 2x2 and centres itself), mirroring heron's own card. On
   mobile it drops into the mint cell's own grid area instead, 88% wide. */
/* R6 §4/§7: centred on the FULL 2x2 crossing put the card's top edge only
   ~15-50px below the headline row at rest, with zero margin for the flip's
   lift or the hover-tilt's foreshortening - both could (and did, measured)
   bring the card within single-digit px of "verksamhet.". Spanning only
   the LOWER row (grid-row:2, still centred horizontally on the vertical
   seam = still "on the crossing") puts the card inside the NV/NH half
   entirely, with a full row-height of clearance above it before ÖV even
   starts. */
.kontakt-card-anchor{
  grid-column:1 / 3;grid-row:2;place-self:center;z-index:5;
  width:min(32vw,460px);aspect-ratio:85/55;perspective:1200px;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .kontakt-card-anchor{grid-area:nh;place-self:center;width:80%;}
}
.kontakt-card-tilt{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
.card-flip2{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;}
.card-flip2 button.face{margin:0;padding:6%;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
.card-flip2 button.face:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.face-back-hit{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;}
.face-back-hit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.card-back-content{position:relative;z-index:1;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;}
.card-back-content a{pointer-events:auto;}
.card-back-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:4px;}
.card-back-links a{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;width:max-content;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- footer */
.footer-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0 0 0 var(--cellpad);height:34vw;max-height:340px;min-height:200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;}
.footer-mark{font-size:clamp(80px,16vw,220px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.06em;}
.footer-strip{padding:18px var(--cellpad);background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.footer-strip a{text-decoration:underline;font-size:14px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- resolve (dither -> color) */
.img-cell{position:relative;}
/* R3: §3 dither -> colour grid-stagger. The tile grid sits over the
   already-visible colour layer; each tile shows one slice of the dither
   image and fades on its own random-order schedule, so the resolve reads
   as pixels dissolving away rather than a wipe. Built once at init from
   the existing .dither-layer <img> (see buildTileGrid in the script). */
.tile-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;pointer-events:none;}
.tile-grid > span{display:block;background-repeat:no-repeat;will-change:opacity;}
.color-layer{clip-path:none;}

/* R3: seam-anchored decorations, all created/positioned by the script. */
.seam-line{position:absolute;background:var(--mint);pointer-events:none;z-index:3;}
/* the crosshair seam-draw is a 2x2-grid flourish; hero-stage stacks to one
   column under 768px (see .hero-stage media query above), so the same
   absolute-positioned lines would otherwise bisect the whole stacked
   column top to bottom - hide them there. */
@media (max-width:767px){ .seam-line{display:none;} }
.process-row{position:relative;}
.process-progress{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top center;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;}
/* process-left/process-right only sit side by side at the 1200px+ 12-col
   grid (BYGGSPEC .g12 breakpoints); below that they stack, so the seam
   the progress line marks no longer exists - hide it rather than let a
   stale left-offset poke 2px past the right edge (390/768 overflow). */
@media (max-width:1199px){ .process-progress{display:none;} }

/* R3: SplitText's own mask:'lines'/'words'/'chars' option wraps each split
   unit in its own clipping span, and every heading that gets split already
   sits inside a .cell (overflow:hidden) or .footer-cell (overflow:hidden)
   — so no extra clip rule is needed on the headings themselves (adding one
   risked cutting descenders that round 2's static layout already relies
   on fitting without it). */

/* spacing rhythm between section groups */
.rhythm{height:110px;}
@media (max-width:767px){ .rhythm{height:72px;} }
</style>
</head>

        </div>

              </div>
    </div>

  <div class="rhythm" style="background:#000"></div>

  <!-- ============================================================ PROCESS -->
  <section id="process">
    <div class="g g12 process-row">
      <div class="c-6 cell process-left">
        <div class="process-sticky">
          <p class="process-kicker mono">Vår process:</p>
          <h2 class="process-title headline-40">Från samtal till lanserad sida.</h2>
          <p class="process-lock body">Webbdesign, design och system. Allt på ett ställe.</p>
          <div class="process-image img-cell" data-resolve="process" style="background:var(--grey)">
            <img class="dither-layer" src="assets/dither/k4-cabin-desk-dither-grey.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">
            <img class="color-layer" src="/tests/alunix-concepts-r3/build/assets/k4-cabin-desk.webp" alt="Ett skrivbord i en stuga" loading="lazy" style="clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="c-6 cell cell--pad0 process-right">
        <ol class="process-steps">
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Uppstart</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi börjar med ett samtal om er verksamhet samt vad ni vill att sidan ska göra för er. Utifrån det skapar vi ett initialt underlag som ni rättar innan det går till ritbordet.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Planering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi ritar strukturen som en skiss innan vi formger något. Där ser ni vilka sidor som behövs och vad varje sida ska få besökaren att göra, mobilen först.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Design</h3>
              <p class="process-p">När strukturen står formger vi sidan efter er verksamhet. Förslaget lägger vi på en testadress, där ni ser det på er egen telefon och säger till innan det går till bygge.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Utveckling</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi bygger sidan i kod från grunden, utan färdig mall, så att den laddar snabbt. Texter och bilder ändrar ni själva, och vill ni lägga till mer bygger ni vidare på det vi lämnat.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">05</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Innehåll</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Ni behöver inte ha något färdigt. Det ni har bearbetar vi, bygger vidare på och kompletterar där något saknas. Texten skriver vi åt er, om ni inte vill ha er egen.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">06</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Lansering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Innan sidan publiceras går vi igenom varje länk, formulär och bild. Vi testar den med tangentbord och skärmläsare, på telefon och på dator, och visar er hur ni ändrar innehållet själva.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">07</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Förvaltning</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi finns kvar efter lansering. Nya sidor och ändringar går samma väg som bygget, så ni ser dem på testadressen innan era kunder gör det. Har ni en fråga mejlar ni oss på kontakt@alunix.se.</p></div>
          </li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="rhythm" style="background:#000"></div>

  <!-- ============================================================ EXEMPELCASE: väljare -->

            <span class="h3">Calyx</span>

          <span class="case-choice-frame"><img src="assets/cases/horai-1440.webp" alt="Startsidan för Hōrai, ett Asian fusion-koncept" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy"></span>
          <span class="case-choice-meta" aria-hidden="true">
            <span class="h3">Hōrai</span>
            <span class="mono caption">Restaurang, Asian Fusion</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

  <!-- ============================================================ SHOWCASE (B2): den valda casen, pinnad -->
  <section id="showcase">
    <div class="showcase-stage">
      <div class="showcase-embed-cell">
        <div class="showcase-frame-wrap" id="showcaseFrameWrap">
          <img class="showcase-poster" id="showcasePosterCalyx" src="assets/cases/calyx-1440.webp" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
          <iframe id="showcaseIframeCalyx" data-showcase-src="/sites/calyx.html" scrolling="no" title="Exempelsida: Calyx, florist i Stockholm"></iframe>
          <img class="showcase-poster" id="showcasePosterHorai" src="assets/cases/horai-1440.webp" alt="" aria-hidden="true" style="display:none">
          <iframe id="showcaseIframeHorai" data-showcase-src="/sites/horai.html" scrolling="no" title="Exempelsida: Hōrai, Asian fusion-koncept" style="display:none"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="showcase-side">
        <div class="showcase-panel showcase-panel--calyx" id="showcase-calyx" aria-labelledby="calyx-title">
          <div class="cell showcase-head" style="background:var(--rust)">
            <h2 id="calyx-title" class="headline-40">Calyx</h2>
            <p class="mono caption" style="margin-top:8px;">Florist, Stockholm</p>
          </div>
          <div class="showcase-rows">
            <div class="showcase-box-head" aria-hidden="true">
              <span class="showcase-counter mono">01 / 05</span>
              <div class="showcase-track"><div class="showcase-track-fill"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="showcase-steps">
              <div class="showcase-row is-active" data-row="0"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Fotot bär rubriken</h3><p>Vi byggde Calyx som ett tidskriftsnummer, med utgåvan i hörnet och rubriken direkt på fotot. En bukett vill man röra vid, och på en skärm kommer ett stort foto närmast.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="1"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">En serif för allt man läser</h3><p>Rubriker och brödtext står i samma klassiska serif, och kursiven sköter betoningen. Ett andra rubriktypsnitt hade dragit åt reklam. Det enda andra typsnittet är skrivmaskinslikt och används till etiketter och bildtexter, som anteckningar i marginalen.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="2"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Färgen finns redan i bilderna</h3><p>Fotona står parvis med en liten märkning under varje, som i en katalog. Grunden är varmt, nästan vitt papper med ett svagt korn. Sidan har en enda egen färg, en rostton, och den dyker upp först längre ned.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="3"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Utbudet som prislista</h3><p>Veckans utbud står i en lista med löpnummer, namn, en kort beskrivning och priset till höger. Kort i ett rutnät hade krävt ett nytt foto av varje bukett varje vecka. Med en lista räcker det att skriva om en rad.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="4"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Ett mejl räcker</h3><p>Sidan slutar med hur en beställning går till. Besökaren skriver om rummet och ljuset, och ateljén svarar med vad som finns den veckan. Sådant passar dåligt i formulärfält, så vi satte en e-postadress där formuläret annars hade stått.</p></div></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="showcase-panel showcase-panel--horai" id="showcase-horai" aria-labelledby="horai-title" style="display:none" inert>
          <div class="cell showcase-head" style="background:var(--lacquer)">
            <h2 id="horai-title" class="headline-40">Hōrai</h2>
            <p class="mono caption" style="margin-top:8px;">Restaurang, Asian Fusion</p>
          </div>
          <div class="showcase-rows">
            <div class="showcase-box-head" aria-hidden="true">
              <span class="showcase-counter mono">01 / 06</span>
              <div class="showcase-track"><div class="showcase-track-fill"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="showcase-steps">
              <div class="showcase-row is-active" data-row="0"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Namnet står en gång</h3><p>Första skärmen är ett mörkt foto med namnet i stora versaler och öppettiderna i hörnet. Loggan i menyraden tänds när bilden rullat förbi, så namnet står bara en gång på första skärmen.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="1"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">Stycket tänds i er takt</h3><p>Stycket om huset börjar nästan osynligt och tänds ord för ord medan ni scrollar. Vi ville att det skulle läsas långsamt, som när någon berättar. Rubriken står kvar i rött, med ett japanskt tecken ovanför som en stämpel.</p></div></div>
              <div class="showcase-row" data-row="2"><div class="showcase-row-text"><h3 class="h3">En mening som saktar in</h3><p>Mellan huset och menyerna står en enda mening på mörk grund. Den är suddig tills den når mitten av skärmen och suddas ut igen när ni scrollar vidare. Den står där för att bromsa läsningen före menyer och priser.</p></div></div>

<script src="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="assets/vendor/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="assets/vendor/SplitText.min.js"></script>
<script src="assets/vendor/lenis.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText);

  /* ============================================================ §0 motorn
     Lenis <-> GSAP wiring per lenis-skillen, ordagrant: autoRaf:false,
     gsap.ticker som enda RAF-drivare, lagSmoothing(0), scroll -> ST.update.
     respectReducedMotion:false: rörelse spelar alltid (F-011, spec §0). ----- */
  var lenis = new Lenis({ autoRaf: false, anchors: true, respectReducedMotion: false, lerp: 0.1 });
  window.__lenis = lenis; /* dev hook: lets §10's jump-test drive lenis.scrollTo(...,{immediate:true}) */
  gsap.ticker.add(function(time){ lenis.raf(time * 1000); });
  gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0);
  lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);

  /* R5 fix: a ScrollTrigger.refresh() that lands WHILE the calyx showcase
     iframe is still navigating (its 'load' hasn't fired yet - a live
     same-origin document loading INSIDE an already-pinned element) reliably
     threw "insertBefore ... no longer a child" from ScrollTrigger's own
     pin-revert step, reproduced by bisecting away pin/scrub/onRefresh/the
     iframe itself one at a time until only "pin + a loading iframe inside
     it" remained. fonts.ready, every not-yet-loaded <img>'s load event, and
     the two setTimeout sweeps below can all land in that same early window,
     so every refresh() in the file is routed through this one gate: it
     queues (never drops) until the showcase iframe has fully settled, then
     also coalesces same-frame calls into one trailing refresh(). */
  var __showcaseIframeSettled = false;
  var __refreshTimer = null;
  function safeRefresh(){
    if (!__showcaseIframeSettled){
      if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
      __refreshTimer = setTimeout(safeRefresh, 60);
      return;
    }
    if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
    __refreshTimer = setTimeout(function(){ __refreshTimer = null; ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 200);
  }

  /* ----- lazy iframe mount, same sweep principle as V3e, now driven by the
     Lenis scroll event instead of a native scroll listener so it keeps
     firing during smoothed scroll, on anchors, and on a straight jump. ----- */
  var frames = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('iframe[data-src]'));
  var AHEAD = 2;
  var defer = window.requestIdleCallback
    ? function(fn){ requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: 600 }); }
    : function(fn){ setTimeout(fn, 1); };
  function mountFrame(f){
    var src = f.getAttribute('data-src');
    if (!src) return;
    f.addEventListener('load', function(){ safeRefresh(); }, { once: true });
    f.src = src;
    f.removeAttribute('data-src');
  }
  function mountDue(){
    if (!frames.length) return;
    var edge = window.innerHeight * AHEAD;
    for (var i = frames.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      if (frames[i].getBoundingClientRect().top < edge){
        (function(f){ defer(function(){ mountFrame(f); }); })(frames[i]);
        frames.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  lenis.on('scroll', mountDue);
  addEventListener('load', mountDue);
  mountDue();

  /* ----- refresh triggers: fonts, and every image not yet loaded ----- */
  Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')).forEach(function(img){
    if (img.complete) return;
    img.addEventListener('load', function(){ safeRefresh(); }, { once: true });
  });
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready){
    document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ safeRefresh(); }).catch(function(){});
  }

  var isNarrow = window.innerWidth < 768;

  /* ============================================================ §3 dither -> färg
     GSAP grid-stagger (cyphr-studio lån, byggspec §1): each image cell
     gets a tile grid of <span>s cut from the dither image, layered over
     the now fully-visible colour layer. Tiles fade out on a random-order
     schedule scrubbed to the cell's own scroll range, so the resolve reads
     as pixels dissolving away, reversible on scroll-back. Hero cells
     (data-resolve="stay") keep their flat dither look and are excluded,
     per spec §3 ("alla bildceller utom heron"). ----- */
  function buildTileGrid(cell, rows, cols){
    var dither = cell.querySelector('.dither-layer');
    var color = cell.querySelector('.color-layer');
    if (!dither || !color) return null;
    gsap.set(color, { clipPath: 'inset(0px 0px 0px 0px)' });
    var src = dither.getAttribute('src');
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'tile-grid';
    grid.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(' + cols + ',1fr)';
    grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(' + rows + ',1fr)';
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    var tiles = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++){
      for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++){
        var t = document.createElement('span');
        t.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + src + ')';
        t.style.backgroundSize = (cols * 100) + '% ' + (rows * 100) + '%';
        t.style.backgroundPosition = (cols < 2 ? 0 : (c / (cols - 1) * 100)) + '% ' + (rows < 2 ? 0 : (r / (rows - 1) * 100)) + '%';
        frag.appendChild(t);
        tiles.push(t);
      }
    }
    grid.appendChild(frag);
    cell.appendChild(grid);
    dither.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    return tiles;
  }

  var resolveCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.img-cell[data-resolve]'));
  var tileDims = isNarrow ? [6, 6] : [12, 8];
  resolveCells.forEach(function(cell){
    if (cell.getAttribute('data-resolve') === 'stay') return;
    var tiles = buildTileGrid(cell, tileDims[0], tileDims[1]);
    if (!tiles) return;
    gsap.to(tiles, {
      opacity: 0,
      stagger: { grid: tileDims, from: 'random', amount: 0.9 },
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: cell, start: 'top 85%', end: 'center 55%',
        scrub: true, invalidateOnRefresh: true
      }
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================ small helper:
     a colour-matched fill that reveals from an element's left seam via
     clip-path, standing in for "cellens bakgrund fylls från sin skarv"
     wherever the spec asks for it (§4 tes-lines, §7 case heads). Keeps the
     original text above it (z-index) so nothing is ever covered. ----- */
  function seamFill(cell, fromClip){
    var cs = getComputedStyle(cell);
    var bg = cs.backgroundColor;
    if (!bg || bg === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') return null;
    var fill = document.createElement('div');
    fill.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    fill.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:' + bg + ';clip-path:' + (fromClip || 'inset(0 100% 0 0)') + ';';
    if (getComputedStyle(cell).position === 'static') cell.style.position = 'relative';
    cell.insertBefore(fill, cell.firstChild);
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(cell.children, function(child){
      if (child === fill) return;
      if (getComputedStyle(child).position === 'static') child.style.position = 'relative';
      child.style.zIndex = child.style.zIndex || '1';
    });
    cell.style.background = 'transparent';
    return fill;
  }

  /* R4 fix: SplitText's mask:'…' wrapper clips to a tight box, and the
     headlines here run at line-height:.8-1 - tight enough that a
     descender (g, y, p) gets sliced by that box's own bottom edge. Give
     every mask wrapper a hair of bottom breathing room via padding+
     matching negative margin, so the box grows without shifting layout
     (the negative margin cancels the padding's added height). ----- */
  function maskBreathe(instance){
    if (!instance || !instance.masks) return;
    instance.masks.forEach(function(m){
      m.style.paddingBottom = '0.16em';
      m.style.marginBottom = '-0.16em';
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================ §1 laddning
     · heron sätts ihop (once, <=1.4s). Cellerna öppnas med clip-path FRÅN
     sin skarv (det inre hörnet mot korsningen), inte från kanten: fjärde
     cellen (NH) sist, i diagonal ordning ÖV -> ÖH+NV -> NH. ----- */
  var heroStageEl = document.querySelector('.hero-stage');
  var HERO_SEAMS = [
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-ov'), from: 'inset(100% 0% 0% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-oh'), from: 'inset(100% 100% 0% 0%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nv'), from: 'inset(0% 0% 100% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nh'), from: 'inset(0% 100% 100% 0%)' }
  ];
  HERO_SEAMS.forEach(function(s){ if (s.el) gsap.set(s.el, { clipPath: s.from }); });

  var seamV = document.createElement('div');
  seamV.className = 'seam-line';
  seamV.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  seamV.style.cssText = 'left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:50% 0%;';
  var seamH = document.createElement('div');
  seamH.className = 'seam-line';
  seamH.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  seamH.style.cssText = 'top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0% 50%;';
  if (heroStageEl){ heroStageEl.appendChild(seamV); heroStageEl.appendChild(seamH); }

  var h1Split = SplitText.create('.hero-h1', { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
  gsap.set(h1Split.lines, { yPercent: 100 });
  maskBreathe(h1Split);

  var cardAnchor = document.getElementById('cardAnchor');
  var cardFlip = document.getElementById('cardFlip');
  gsap.set(cardAnchor, { opacity: 0, y: -48, rotation: -3, transformOrigin: '50% 0%' });

  var loadTl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power2.out' } });
  loadTl
    .to([seamV, seamH], { scaleX: 1, scaleY: 1, duration: 0.26, ease: 'power1.out' }, 0)
    .to(HERO_SEAMS[0].el, { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.48 }, 0.14)
    .to([HERO_SEAMS[1].el, HERO_SEAMS[2].el], { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.48 }, 0.36)
    .to(HERO_SEAMS[3].el, { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.42 }, 0.58)
    .to(h1Split.lines, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power4.out', stagger: 0.08 }, 0.4)
    .to(cardAnchor, { opacity: 1, y: 0, rotation: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' }, 0.75);

  /* ============================================================ §2 heron
     under scroll: pin på desktop (~120% viewport), scrub:0.6. Ingen pin på
     mobil - kortare, ren scrub-koreografi över hero-wrap:s naturliga höjd. */
  /* give the ÖH/NV dither layers overscan headroom before parallaxing them:
     an object-fit:cover image translated by a %-of-own-height can expose
     the cell's own grey fallback background at the opposite edge once it
     moves - scaling up first keeps the cover intact through the full
     +/-8% yPercent range used below. */
  gsap.set('.hero-oh .dither-layer, .hero-nv .dither-layer', { scale: 1.18 });

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add({ isDesktop: '(min-width:768px)', isMobile: '(max-width:767px)' }, function(context){
    var isDesktop = context.conditions.isDesktop;
    var stCfg = isDesktop
      ? { trigger: '#hero', start: 'top top', end: '+=120%', scrub: 0.6, pin: '.hero-stage', pinSpacing: true, anticipatePin: 1 }
      : { trigger: '#hero', start: 'top top', end: '+=60%', scrub: 0.6 };
    /* R5 §A: h1 fick förut samma yPercent-drift som kortvändningen (position
       0), vilket kunde skära cellens h1 innan besökaren hunnit läsa den.
       Timeline-positioner nedan är TIDER i en 1-enhets skala (varje .to
       ovan har fått en explicit duration som summerar till 1), så en
       position på 0.75 = sista fjärdedelen av pinnen, exakt när
       kortvändningen (som pågår hela 0..1) är i sitt sista skede. h1 rör
       sig därför bara i den sista fjärdedelen - resten av pinnen (90 av
       120 vh) står den helt stilla och läsbar. */
    var heroTl = gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: stCfg, defaults: { ease: 'none' } });
    heroTl
      .to(cardFlip, { rotationY: 180, scale: 1.04, transformOrigin: '50% 50%', ease: 'power1.inOut', duration: 1 }, 0)
      .to('.hero-oh .dither-layer', { yPercent: -8, duration: 1 }, 0)
      .to('.hero-nv .dither-layer', { yPercent: 8, duration: 1 }, 0)
      .fromTo('.hero-nh', { clipPath: 'inset(28% 0% 0% 0%)' }, { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', ease: 'power1.out', duration: 0.32 }, 0.68)
      .to(h1Split.lines, { yPercent: function(i){ return -16 - i * 12; }, duration: 0.25 }, 0.75);
  });

  /* ============================================================ §4 tesen */
  var tesHeadline = document.querySelector('.tes-top .headline-50');
  if (tesHeadline){
    /* R4 fix: chars-only splitting on a multi-word sentence broke words
       mid-character (each char became its own breakable inline-block with
       no word memory). Split lines > words > chars instead, mask at the
       LINE level (so line 2 can never visually overlap line 1 - each line
       is its own normal-flow box, only its own chars animate inside it),
       and force every word to stay a single non-breaking unit so the
       browser only ever wraps between words, never inside one. */
    var tesSplit = SplitText.create(tesHeadline, { type: 'lines, words, chars', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
    gsap.set(tesSplit.words, { whiteSpace: 'nowrap', display: 'inline-block' });
    maskBreathe(tesSplit);
    gsap.set(tesSplit.chars, { yPercent: 100 });
    gsap.to(tesSplit.chars, {
      yPercent: 0, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power4.out', stagger: 0.012,
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.tes-top', start: 'top 82%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
    });
    /* R5 §A: the horizontal xPercent drift risked shearing the last word
       off the right edge before it had been read, and never satisfied the
       >=40vh fully-on-screen window. Replaced with a pin (desktop only,
       spec: "pinna tesens övre cell ... i ~90 vh"): the cell holds fixed
       while the char-rise above plays, then stands completely still for
       the remainder of the pinned range (>=50vh) before releasing. Mobile
       keeps no pin (spec), just the char-rise above. */
    gsap.matchMedia().add('(min-width:768px)', function(){
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: '#tes', start: 'top top', end: function(){ return '+=' + (0.9 * window.innerHeight); },
        pin: '.tes-top', pinSpacing: true, anticipatePin: 1
      });
    });
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tes-line'), function(cell){
    var p = cell.querySelector('p');
    var fill = seamFill(cell, 'inset(0 100% 0 0)');
    if (fill){
      gsap.to(fill, {
        clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0)', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: cell, start: 'top 82%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
      });
    }
    if (p){
      var lineSplit = SplitText.create(p, { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
      maskBreathe(lineSplit);
      gsap.set(lineSplit.lines, { yPercent: 100 });
      gsap.to(lineSplit.lines, {
        yPercent: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.05,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: cell, start: 'top 80%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
      });
    }
  });

  /* ============================================================ §5 processen */
  var processRow = document.querySelector('.process-row');
  if (processRow){
    var progress = document.createElement('div');
    progress.className = 'process-progress';
    progress.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    processRow.appendChild(progress);
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: processRow, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom',
      onRefresh: function(self){
        var r = processRow.getBoundingClientRect();
        var leftCol = processRow.querySelector('.process-left');
        var lr = leftCol ? leftCol.getBoundingClientRect() : r;
        progress.style.left = (lr.right - r.left) + 'px';
      }
    });
    gsap.to(progress, {
      scaleY: 1, ease: 'none',
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: processRow, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom', scrub: true }
    });
  }
  /* R4 fix: dimming the whole <li> via autoAlpha:0.55 dragged process-p
     (already #bdbdbd, a deliberately quieter grey) down to ~3.8:1 against
     black - below AA (measured ~3.9:1 by the lead, confirms the same
     defect). autoAlpha/opacity is a paint-blend against the black cell,
     not a fixed colour, so its contrast isn't controllable independently
     of the colour under it. Fix: never dim process-p at all (it stays a
     constant #bdbdbd, 11.2:1, always AA-safe); only the title + index
     toggle, and they toggle an explicit colour (not opacity) so the
     inactive value is a guaranteed, measurable 6.5:1 - not a computed
     blend. This is a discrete state toggle on ScrollTrigger's onToggle
     (fires once per crossing, not per scroll frame), not a continuous
     scrub, so animating `color` here doesn't reintroduce the perf cost
     the transform/opacity/clip-path-only rule guards against. */
  var STEP_DIM = '#8f8f8f';
  var STEP_LIT = '#ffffff';
  var processSteps = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.process-row-item'));
  processSteps.forEach(function(step){
    var num = step.querySelector('.process-num');
    var title = step.querySelector('.process-step-title');
    if (title) gsap.set(title, { color: STEP_DIM });
    if (num) gsap.set(num, { color: STEP_DIM });
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: step, start: 'top center', end: 'bottom center',
      onToggle: function(self){
        var lit = self.isActive ? STEP_LIT : STEP_DIM;
        if (title) gsap.to(title, { color: lit, duration: 0.3, overwrite: 'auto' });
        if (num){
          gsap.to(num, { color: lit, duration: 0.3, overwrite: 'auto' });
          gsap.fromTo(num, { yPercent: self.isActive ? -100 : 100 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.3, overwrite: 'auto' });
        }
      }
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================ §6 exempelcase */
  /* R5 §A: "Exempelcase" must never be sheared by either edge - the old
     xPercent drift (20 -> -6, scrub) risked exactly that, and the spec
     explicitly asks for a yPercent reveal out of a mask instead. The word
     already fits its cell at rest (case-word-cell has overflow hidden), so
     this is now a one-time rise, not a scroll-scrubbed horizontal pan. */
  var caseWord = document.querySelector('.case-word-cell .headline-50');
  if (caseWord){
    var caseWordSplit = SplitText.create(caseWord, { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
    maskBreathe(caseWordSplit);
    gsap.set(caseWordSplit.lines, { yPercent: 100 });
    gsap.to(caseWordSplit.lines, {

<!doctype html>
<html lang="sv">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>ALUNIX</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/lenis.css">

<style>
@font-face{
  font-family:"Geist";
  src:url("assets/fonts/geist-500-latin.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-weight:500; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}
@font-face{
  font-family:"Geist Mono";
  src:url("assets/fonts/geist-mono-400-latin.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-weight:400; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}

:root{
  --paper:#ffffff;
  --ink:#232323;
  --black:#000000;
  --grey:#d9d9d9;
  --mint:#0af474;
  --mint-soft:#a3fbcb;
  --rust:#9c5a3a;
  --lacquer:#b23524;
  --seam:1px solid #000;

  --headline-50:clamp(3.25rem, 0.418rem + 12.082vw, 12.5rem);
  --headline-40:clamp(2.5rem, 1.352rem + 4.9vw, 6.25rem);
  --headline-20:clamp(2rem, 1.694rem + 1.306vw, 3rem);
  --h3:38px;
  --body:16px;
  --body-30:clamp(1.5rem, 1.347rem + 0.653vw, 2rem);
  --caption:13px;
  --cellpad:20px;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{color-scheme:light;}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:#000;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:"Geist","Arial",system-ui,sans-serif;
  font-weight:500;
  line-height:1.3;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono","Consolas",monospace;font-weight:400;}
h1,h2,h3,p,ol,ul,figure{margin:0;padding:0;}
a{color:inherit;}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- rutverket shell */
.rutverk{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;background:#000;}
.rutverk > section{scroll-margin-top:48px;}

.g{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.cell{background:var(--paper);padding:var(--cellpad);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cell--pad0{padding:0;}
.cell--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--black{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--grey{background:var(--grey);color:var(--ink);}
.cell--mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--black);}
.cell--rust{background:var(--rust);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--lacquer{background:var(--lacquer);color:var(--paper);}

.g12{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .g12{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .g12{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .g12 > *{grid-column:1 / -1 !important;}
}

.c-2{grid-column:span 2;}
.c-3{grid-column:span 3;}
.c-4{grid-column:span 4;}
.c-5{grid-column:span 5;}
.c-6{grid-column:span 6;}
.c-7{grid-column:span 7;}
.c-8{grid-column:span 8;}
.c-12{grid-column:span 12;}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .c-7,.c-5,.c-8,.c-4{grid-column:span 6;}
}

.headline-50{font-size:var(--headline-50);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.headline-40{font-size:var(--headline-40);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.headline-20{font-size:var(--headline-20);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}
.h3{font-size:var(--h3);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;}
.body{font-size:var(--body);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.body-30{font-size:var(--body-30);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.caption{font-size:var(--caption);letter-spacing:0;}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- topline */
.topline{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;height:48px;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:1px;background:#000;
}
.topline-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 20px;}
.topline-logo{width:auto;height:22px;}
.topline-mark{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;}
.topline-mid{background:var(--paper);}
.topline-contact{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;justify-content:flex-end;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- hero */
/* R3: the fixed 190svh CSS-sticky stage is gone. The pin distance is now
   owned by ScrollTrigger's own pinSpacing (desktop matchMedia branch,
   RORELSE-SPEC.md §2); hero-wrap just needs to size to its content so a
   no-JS/pre-JS view still shows one full stage, not a dead 90svh gap. */
.hero-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;}
.hero-stage{
  position:relative;height:calc(100svh - 48px);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  gap:1px;background:#000;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* Mobile drops the pin: no extra scroll-span, no sticky stage. The four
     cells stack in normal flow (each already min-height:60vw, so the
     stack is naturally taller than one screen) and the card flips against
     that natural scroll distance instead of a dedicated dead-space span. */
  .hero-wrap{height:auto;}
  .hero-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,minmax(60vw,auto));height:auto;position:relative;top:0;}
}
.hero-cell{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-ov{background:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.hero-oh{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nv{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nh{background:var(--mint);}
.hero-h1{max-width:14ch;}

.dither-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.color-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}

/* card: a physical object (light stock, ink edge, hard offset shadow) so
   it reads against a black cell instead of disappearing into it. ~1.6x
   the R1 size at 1440 (was ~340px wide, now ~520px), 85:55 kept. */
.card-anchor{
  position:absolute;left:75%;top:50%;
  width:min(36vw,520px);
  aspect-ratio:85/55;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  perspective:1600px;
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@media (max-width:767px){ .card-anchor{left:50%;top:120vw;width:min(74vw,380px);} }
.card-flip{
  width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
  transform:rotateY(calc(var(--flip,0) * 180deg));
  box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;
}
.face{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:#fff;
  backface-visibility:hidden;
  border:1px solid #000;
  overflow:hidden;
}
/* A visible white mat around the photo, not a full-bleed image: a card
   that is a photo edge-to-edge reads as "the photo", not as "a light
   stock object sitting on the cell" - the mat is what makes the white
   stock actually visible against a black ÖH ground. */
.face--front{background:#fff;padding:6%;}
/* R6 bugfix: kontakt's front is a <button> wrapping <span>s (spans, unlike
   hero's <div>s, default to display:inline) - an inline, merely
   position:relative .photo never gets a real box (width/height are ignored
   on non-replaced inline elements), so it collapsed to a ~2px sliver and
   the absolutely-positioned img inside inherited that zero-size containing
   block. display:block here makes both tags behave identically. */
.face--front .photo{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
.face--back{
  transform:rotateY(180deg);
  background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:6% 8%;
}
.face--front img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.mark-dock{position:absolute;top:9%;left:9%;width:14%;z-index:2;}
.mark-dock svg{width:100%;height:auto;fill:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7));}
.card-mark{font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;}
.card-kicker{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,14px);opacity:.65;margin:2px 0 0;}
.card-rule{border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25);margin:6px 0;width:100%;}
.card-services{display:flex;gap:10px;font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(10px,1.1vw,13px);}
.card-cta{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;margin-top:4px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- tes */
.tes-top{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.tes-top .headline-50{max-width:22ch;}
.tes-lower{min-height:104svh;}
.tes-stack{display:grid;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:#000;}
.tes-line{padding:var(--cellpad);display:flex;align-items:center;}
.tes-image{padding:0;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- process */
.process-row{}
.process-left{background:var(--grey);}
.process-sticky{position:sticky;top:calc(48px + var(--cellpad));}
.process-kicker{margin-bottom:14px;}
.process-title{margin:0 0 18px;max-width:11ch;}
.process-lock{max-width:32ch;opacity:.8;}
.process-image{position:relative;margin-top:32px;aspect-ratio:1/1;width:100%;max-width:680px;border:1px solid #000;overflow:hidden;}
.process-right{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0;}
.process-steps{list-style:none;}
.process-row-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:22px var(--cellpad);border-top:1px solid #000;}
.process-row-item:first-child{border-top:none;}
.process-num{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:13px;padding-top:4px;}
.process-step-title{margin:0 0 6px;}
.process-p{color:#bdbdbd;max-width:56ch;font-size:15px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- exempelcase */
/* R5 §A bugfix: 0.6x bottom padding (12px) was less than the SplitText
   mask-breathe allowance (0.16em, ~16-20px at this clamp size) needs to
   clear the word's own descenders before the cell's overflow:hidden edge
   - verify_motion.py's legibility scan caught the word's rendered box
   (with its mask wrapper's padding-bottom) genuinely sitting a few px
   below the cell's clip boundary at every scroll position (0vh visible,
   not >=40vh). Matching the top padding removes the clip entirely. */
.case-word-cell{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4 + 4px);overflow:hidden;}
.case-word-cell .headline-50{max-width:100%;}

/* R5 §B1: väljaren - två knappar, skarpa 1440x900-vyer, ingen beskärande zoom */
.case-picker-cell{padding:0 var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.2);background:#000;}
.case-picker{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.case-choice{
  display:block;width:100%;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:var(--paper);color:inherit;
  font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
}
.case-choice-frame{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:var(--grey);}
.case-choice-frame img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);will-change:transform;}
@media (hover:hover){
  .case-choice:hover .case-choice-frame img,
  .case-choice:focus-visible .case-choice-frame img{transform:scale(1.04);}
}
.case-choice:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:-2px;}
.case-choice-meta{display:block;padding:16px var(--cellpad) 20px;border-bottom:4px solid transparent;}
.case-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .case-choice-meta{border-bottom-color:var(--mint);}
.case-choice-meta .h3{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:22px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- showcase (B2/C) */
.showcase-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
@media (min-width:768px){ .showcase-stage{grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;} }
.showcase-embed-cell{padding:0;background:var(--paper);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-frame-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-poster{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.showcase-embed-cell iframe{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1440px;height:900px;border:0;background:var(--paper);
  transform-origin:top left;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .showcase-embed-cell{position:sticky;top:48px;height:56svh;z-index:2;}
}
@media (min-width:768px){
  /* R6 §3, two stacked causes, both fixed here:
     1) .showcase-side's natural content (all 5/6 rows, R5's rise-mask kept
        every body visible at once) was taller than the embed cell's
        explicit height. A CSS grid item with an explicit height does not
        stretch to match a taller sibling's row track - the TRACK grows to
        fit the tall side instead, leaving the embed cell short of the
        row's actual height by the difference (measured ~110px), exposing
        the stage's own black gap background below the frame. Pinning both
        columns to the SAME explicit height (with the side's own
        overflow-y:auto as a never-clip safety net) makes them structurally
        impossible to mismatch, regardless of how much text a future edit
        adds.
     2) That explicit height was `100svh - 48px`, sized to sit BELOW the
        48px sticky topline - but the pin (`start:'top top'`) puts the
        section's rendered top at the viewport's own y:0, with the topline
        merely painted on top of (not offsetting) its first 48px. The
        result: content correctly avoids the topline visually, but then
        runs 48px short of the viewport's bottom edge, showing the stage's
        black background as a trailing band under both columns (measured:
        embed/side bottom at 852 of a 900-tall viewport). Hero's own pin
        has this identical 48px arithmetic and gap - invisible there only
        because it lands on the page's own black background either side.
        Showcase's is visible because there's real content flush above it.
        Fixed the same way hero's is invisible: fill the FULL viewport
        (100svh) - the topline still visually covers the top 48px (it's
        position:sticky, z-index:40, opaque), but the bottom now lands
        exactly on the viewport edge, so no gap is left to expose. */
  .showcase-embed-cell{height:100svh;}
  .showcase-side{height:100svh;overflow-y:auto;}
}
.showcase-side{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.showcase-panel{display:contents;}
.showcase-head{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad);}
.showcase-head .headline-40{margin-bottom:8px;}

/* R7 §C: the accordion ledger (R6 §1/§2) is replaced on desktop by a single
   crossfading box - one background for the whole "ruta", every step
   grid-stacked in one cell and GSAP-scrubbed by the showcase pin's onUpdate
   (never a class-toggle). Mobile keeps R6's stacked-rows layout unchanged;
   only its opacity mechanism changes (measured contrast fix, see below). */
.showcase-row{padding:var(--cellpad);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
.showcase-row h3{margin-bottom:0;}
.showcase-row p{max-width:52ch;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px;}

@media (min-width:768px){
  .showcase-rows{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;height:100%;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-rows{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-rows{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-box-head{padding:var(--cellpad) var(--cellpad) 0;}
  .showcase-counter{display:block;font-size:13px;}
  .showcase-track{position:relative;height:4px;margin-top:10px;}
  .showcase-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:#000;transform:translateY(-50%);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-track::before{background:var(--paper);opacity:.3;}
  .showcase-track-fill{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:4px;background:var(--mint);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0);}
  .showcase-steps{display:grid;height:100%;}
  .showcase-row{grid-area:1/1;height:100%;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .showcase-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;background:#000;}
  .showcase-box-head{display:none;}
  .showcase-steps{display:contents;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd) p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- pris */
.pris-statement{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.pris-statement .body-30{max-width:60ch;margin-top:16px;font-weight:500;}
/* All placement lives in these classes (not inline styles) so the media
   queries below can actually win the cascade at each breakpoint. */
.pris-bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);grid-template-rows:auto auto;}
.pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 6;grid-row:1 / span 2;background:var(--mint);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.pris-tier{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;min-height:220px;}
.pris-tier-a{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:1;background:var(--paper);}
.pris-tier-b{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:2;background:var(--grey);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 2;grid-row:1;}
  .pris-tier-a{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;}
  .pris-tier-b{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .pris-lead,.pris-tier-a,.pris-tier-b{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;min-height:0;}
}
.price-label{max-width:34ch;font-size:15px;}
.price-value{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.price-value .unit{font-size:.5em;margin-left:2px;}
.price-value--text{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px);}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- kontakt (R5 §C: heron speglad) */
.kontakt-quad{
  position:relative;display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;min-height:100svh;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-areas:"ov oh" "nv nh";
}
.kontakt-q{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.kontakt-q--ov{grid-area:ov;background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;}
/* R6 §4: headline-40 is tuned for a single "jätteord" (hero, case names) -
   at this cell's half-page width, a four-word sentence in it ran past the
   ÖV/ÖH seam (measured x>720 at 1440, into the card's own space). A
   smaller, dedicated clamp - same family as the old kontakt-giant's - fits
   three lines comfortably inside the cell at 1440/1280/768, verified with
   getBoundingClientRect against the cell box, not eyeballed. */
.kontakt-q--ov h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.75rem, 1.1rem + 2.6vw, 3.4rem);line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:500;max-width:12ch;
}
.kontakt-q--ov p{max-width:32ch;font-size:15px;}
.kontakt-q--oh{grid-area:oh;background:var(--paper);}
.kontakt-q--nv{grid-area:nv;background:var(--grey);padding:0;}
.kontakt-q--nh{grid-area:nh;background:var(--mint);}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* R6 §7: nh gets more room than ov/nv (was the same minmax(60vw) as
     both) - a 3D Y-axis rotation's perspective projection genuinely bulges
     a flat card's rendered bounding box taller at the near edge as it
     turns (measured: +/-28px top/bottom at 1200px perspective, still
     +/-24px at 3000px - foreshortening a rotated rectangle really does
     grow its axis-aligned bbox, not a rounding artefact), and centring an
     88%-wide card in a 60vw-tall row left only ~27px clearance to the
     subline above - not enough to survive that bulge at any angle in the
     0-180deg sweep. */
  .kontakt-quad{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(60vw,auto) minmax(76vw,auto) minmax(60vw,auto);grid-template-areas:"ov" "nh" "nv";min-height:auto;}
  .kontakt-q--oh{display:none;}
}

/* the card sits on the crossing of all four quadrants (a grid item that
   spans the full 2x2 and centres itself), mirroring heron's own card. On
   mobile it drops into the mint cell's own grid area instead, 88% wide. */
/* R6 §4/§7: centred on the FULL 2x2 crossing put the card's top edge only
   ~15-50px below the headline row at rest, with zero margin for the flip's
   lift or the hover-tilt's foreshortening - both could (and did, measured)
   bring the card within single-digit px of "verksamhet.". Spanning only
   the LOWER row (grid-row:2, still centred horizontally on the vertical
   seam = still "on the crossing") puts the card inside the NV/NH half
   entirely, with a full row-height of clearance above it before ÖV even
   starts. */
.kontakt-card-anchor{
  grid-column:1 / 3;grid-row:2;place-self:center;z-index:5;
  width:min(32vw,460px);aspect-ratio:85/55;perspective:1200px;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .kontakt-card-anchor{grid-area:nh;place-self:center;width:80%;}
}
.kontakt-card-tilt{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
.card-flip2{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;}
.card-flip2 button.face{margin:0;padding:6%;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
.card-flip2 button.face:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.face-back-hit{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;}
.face-back-hit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.card-back-content{position:relative;z-index:1;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;}
.card-back-content a{pointer-events:auto;}
.card-back-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:4px;}
.card-back-links a{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;width:max-content;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- footer */
.footer-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0 0 0 var(--cellpad);height:34vw;max-height:340px;min-height:200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;}
.footer-mark{font-size:clamp(80px,16vw,220px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.06em;}
.footer-strip{padding:18px var(--cellpad);background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.footer-strip a{text-decoration:underline;font-size:14px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- resolve (dither -> color) */
.img-cell{position:relative;}
/* R3: §3 dither -> colour grid-stagger. The tile grid sits over the
   already-visible colour layer; each tile shows one slice of the dither
   image and fades on its own random-order schedule, so the resolve reads
   as pixels dissolving away rather than a wipe. Built once at init from
   the existing .dither-layer <img> (see buildTileGrid in the script). */
.tile-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;pointer-events:none;}
.tile-grid > span{display:block;background-repeat:no-repeat;will-change:opacity;}
.color-layer{clip-path:none;}

/* R3: seam-anchored decorations, all created/positioned by the script. */
.seam-line{position:absolute;background:var(--mint);pointer-events:none;z-index:3;}
/* the crosshair seam-draw is a 2x2-grid flourish; hero-stage stacks to one
   column under 768px (see .hero-stage media query above), so the same
   absolute-positioned lines would otherwise bisect the whole stacked
   column top to bottom - hide them there. */
@media (max-width:767px){ .seam-line{display:none;} }
.process-row{position:relative;}
.process-progress{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top center;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;}
/* process-left/process-right only sit side by side at the 1200px+ 12-col
   grid (BYGGSPEC .g12 breakpoints); below that they stack, so the seam
   the progress line marks no longer exists - hide it rather than let a
   stale left-offset poke 2px past the right edge (390/768 overflow). */
@media (max-width:1199px){ .process-progress{display:none;} }

/* R3: SplitText's own mask:'lines'/'words'/'chars' option wraps each split
   unit in its own clipping span, and every heading that gets split already
   sits inside a .cell (overflow:hidden) or .footer-cell (overflow:hidden)
   — so no extra clip rule is needed on the headings themselves (adding one
   risked cutting descenders that round 2's static layout already relies
   on fitting without it). */

/* spacing rhythm between section groups */
.rhythm{height:110px;}
@media (max-width:767px){ .rhythm{height:72px;} }
</style>
</head>

          <h2 class="process-title headline-40">Från samtal till lanserad sida.</h2>

          <div class="process-image img-cell" data-resolve="process" style="background:var(--grey)">
